infoPlist.NSBluetoothAlwaysUsageDescription: Sub60 Audio Pacer needs Bluetooth to read real-time heart rate from your HUAWEI WATCH FIT 4 (BLE standard 0x180D) even when iPhone screen is locked.
infoPlist.NSBluetoothPeripheralUsageDescription: Sub60 Audio Pacer needs Bluetooth to connect to HUAWEI WATCH FIT 4 and monitor your cardiac safety threshold at 178 bpm.
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Sub60 Audio Pacer needs precise GPS to calculate your rolling pace and running distance.
infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: Sub60 Audio Pacer needs background GPS (Always) to maintain pace calculation and voice coaching through earphones when your phone screen is locked in your running belt.
infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysUsageDescription: Sub60 Audio Pacer needs continuous background location access to stay uninterrupted when your iPhone screen locks.
infoPlist.NSMotionUsageDescription: Sub60 Audio Pacer uses motion sensors to assist cadence (steps per minute) estimation while running.

plugins.locationAlwaysAndWhenInUsePermission: Allow Sub60 Audio Pacer to use background GPS for real-time pace coaching through your earphones when screen is locked.
plugins.locationAlwaysPermission: Allow Sub60 Audio Pacer to use background GPS continuously.
plugins.locationWhenInUsePermission: Allow Sub60 Audio Pacer to use GPS while running.

plugins.bluetoothAlwaysPermission: Allow Sub60 Audio Pacer to connect via BLE to HUAWEI WATCH FIT 4 for continuous heart rate monitoring while running.
